utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Did Gus promise you a hammer? I hope he remembers to bring it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm not sure, actually. Did he mention that to you?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: No, he didn't mention it to me either. I just hope we're not missing tools when we get there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, I heard about the repair drive. Need any tools or a hand with something?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, multimeters and wrenches. Opal's checking the tool library.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got a multimeter in my shed if you need one. Let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Vik, have you heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday at the community center? It's from 10 to 4!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I heard! It's this Saturday at the community center, from 10 to 4. I've been telling everyone about it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, glad you're spreading the word! By the way, we're coordinating with the school pickup at 3 PM, so if you're free, we could use an extra hand loading up then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Uli, we still need some more volunteers for Saturday. Can you help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sorry, I can't this weekend. Maybe ask someone else?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, Uli. Could you at least mention it to a few folks you see around? Every little bit helps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, have you heard about the repair drive we're organizing? It's going to be a fun community event where we fix broken items together!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? I think it's next Saturday? Not sure, I've got plans.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, no worries! If Saturday doesn't work, maybe you could stop by another time or bring something to fix beforehand?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there's a repair drive happening. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's a community event to help fix up people's homes. I'm hoping to get a set of screwdrivers from it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds great! I have a broken lamp and a toaster I'd love to get fixed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Eli, I heard about the repair drive and was wondering if you're involved. I'd love to help out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I'm helping with the tool list. Gus has a set of screwdrivers we can borrow. What can you bring?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring my soldering iron and a multimeter for electronic repairs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late—what updates do you have for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's set for right after school pickup, and I heard Rey's hoping to get a screwdriver set from it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good to know! Maybe I can bring a screwdriver for Rey if he doesn't get one.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Opal! We're having a repair drive this Saturday. Can you come help out?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure thing, Quinn! I'm already helping with some preparations. See you at the library's back lot on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Opal! See you at the library’s back lot on Saturday. It’s going to be a great day!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, did you hear the repair drive is this Saturday? I'm bringing my old radio.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday? I thought it was today... or maybe that was something else? Either way, I can probably find that wrench I promised Gus.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, definitely Saturday—I double-checked with Quinn. You still have that wrench? I'm hoping to pick up some tips for my radio.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Mina, are you coming to the repair drive on Saturday? I've got my tools ready and we're coordinating with the school pickup at 3 PM.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, Eli told me he's still working on the tool list. Is it actually happening this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, it's definitely this Saturday! Opal has the generator set up, and I've got my tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, people are actually bringing stuff to that repair drive? You're serious?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yeah, I think so—wait, I actually signed up but now I can't remember what I was supposed to bring. Did you decide to join?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Join? I'm still not convinced this whole thing isn't just a pipe dream. What exactly did you sign up to bring?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? It's going to be great!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh Tess, actually the repair drive got moved to Sunday! Still at the community center though, so it's all set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wait, Sunday? I thought it was Saturday! Oh well, thanks for the heads up—I'll make sure to let Mara know too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Oren, any update on the repair drive? I need to know when it's happening.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, I think Vik told me it's this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center? But don't hold me to that—I always mix things up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I keep getting different answers. I'll check with Eli or Vik directly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: But we're sure it's still at the community center, right? I'd hate to carry this toaster for nothing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it's definitely at the community center. I'll come with you and we can fix that toaster together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, great. Let's go then—I'll grab the toaster.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Ira, are you planning to bring anything to the repair drive? We could use more volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I'm planning to bring my old radio that's been acting up. Happy to help out with whatever else is needed too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, that radio sounds like a perfect project! And we'll definitely put you to work—maybe you can help with sign-ins or sorting.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I'm so glad you're interested in the repair drive! It's going to be a fun community event where we fix broken items together. What do you think about joining us?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'm really looking forward to it! I've got my tools ready and I've already coordinated with the school pickup at 3 PM, so I'm all set.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, Mara! The event runs from 10 AM to 3 PM, so you'll have plenty of time before school pickup. I'll see you there!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Noah, are you going to the repair drive on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh, Sunday? I thought it was today. Well, if it's Sunday, I guess I have more time to find my hammer.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, you'll have time to find your hammer. It'll be good to have you there!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late—what updates do you have for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've got the generator ready behind the library, and I'm planning to check the tool library for multimeters and wrenches.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I'll bring my squeaky chair—those tools should help us fix it!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Rey, could you remind me again when and where the repair drive is happening? I want to make sure I have the right tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's right after school pickup at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: After school pickup—got it. And what time does pickup typically end? I want to be precise.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? What about it?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Well, it's happening this Saturday after school pickup, and I was hoping you could help with the tools station.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, this Saturday? I might be busy, but I'll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? You mean fixing up that old truck down the street? Are you serious?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely serious! We're tackling several projects around the neighborhood, not just the truck. It'll be a blast!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you think people are actually gonna drag their broken toasters over to a repair drive? That seems like a stretch.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there's a repair drive happening. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's a community thing to fix up old bikes and appliances, but I can't join this Saturday. I've got some stuff going on at home.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's too bad you can't make it. I was hoping to bring my broken lamp and toaster.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, the repair drive is definitely this weekend, starting Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, Saturday at the community center. Bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, Saturday at the community center, bring tools. It's going to be a full day of fixing things up.
